Canton of Zurich (Zürich) — Guida di Viaggio Svizzera: Cosa Vedere, Trasporti e Cucina

Zürich Altstadt & Limmatquai, Lake Zurich cruises & Uetliberg, Kunsthaus Zürich & Landesmuseum, Winterthur museums & Rhine Falls gateway. Zurich Airport (ZRH) has a mainline SBB railway station underneath the terminal (10 min to Zürich HB).

RegioneCanton of Zurich (Zürich)
Hub PrincipaleZurich Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)
Tutte le Città160

Come Arrivare e Muoversi

Zurich Airport (ZRH) has a mainline SBB railway station underneath the terminal (10 min to Zürich HB).

Cucina Locale e Specialità

  • Zürcher Geschnetzeltes with Rösti
  • Luxemburgerli macarons
  • Fondue in historic guild houses
  • Craft chocolate
